scope: Real BeyondSimulator Lua/Host; not official game, GPU FPS or device acceptance
checks: Native Lua mounts, exact ready logged, both layered actor heads move
Idle roots and feet remain anchored across varied dt
Both attack directions, contact feedback and exact return-to-origin
100 interrupted/repeated attacks, reset, fixed control count
Interrupt active hit flash by counterattack/reset; varied dt recovery
Host rejects negative dt; long dt capped without Lua error or control growth
600 simulated seconds automatic alternating attacks; no control growth or Lua errors
Three stop/start remounts; single click emits exactly one attack log

stress.note: IPC plus Lua update cost, not GPU or device frame time

video.note: Real Host screenshots at deterministic 30 Hz simulation; offline encoded, not live GPU capture
